name: USM Holding
note: Alisher Usmanov's holding company. Consolidated 100% of MegaFon (RIA Novosti/Prime, 2020-03-26); MegaFon's 2022 annual report lists the USM-related LLCs OOO 'AF Telecom Holding' and OOO 'USM Telecom' as MegaFon's sole shareholders (50/50), and Kommersant (June 2025) confirms the same structure. USM's own shareholder composition is not documented in the sources opened. Sanctions on Usmanov are a sanctions record, not a human-rights record under METHOD.md.
